text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen has 
arrived. The "Empress" Air Groove vs. the 
"Otherworldly Runaway" Silence Suzuka.

As the spectators waited with bated 
breath, the curtain was about to rise on a 
fierce battle.

Just before the race... without saying 
much, the two of them stepped forward into 
the showdown.
